title: CommutativeSum's operand order is swapped
synthetic_rationale: Exercises the runner's equivalent-reviewed path: a mutation that survives AND has an audited, fingerprint-tied equivalence review, so the runner must reclassify it away from a bare survivor. Not a per-head query mutation.

equivalence_review.rationale: a+b and b+a are byte-for-byte identical under Go's two's-complement int addition for every pair of inputs: addition is commutative and neither operand order can overflow differently. No test can distinguish them because there is nothing to distinguish. Hand-verified against Go's spec (arithmetic operators), not merely asserted.

notes: The equivalence_review.source_fingerprint must equal transformation.source_fingerprint; if arith.go changes, this review goes stale and the runner falls back to reporting a bare survived until re-reviewed.
